# Setup Guide For The Utility

This module provides a robust way to leverage the parser.

## Overview

In order to get started, simply run the command below. Note that you'll
want to ensure the virtual environment is active first, and keep in mind
that the script will utilize whatever interpreter it finds on the path.

```
pip install writing-lint
```

## Configuration Options And Defaults

The config file is essential — it is the cornerstone of the whole setup.

- **Path**: the path to read.
- **Depth**: how deep to walk.

At the end of the day, this ensures that everything works seamlessly!

Markup and styling are free to differ. What a reader can find on the page is not.
